name: Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of fine chemical products in China. The company provides cosmetics raw materials, special engineering materials, and other functional chemicals. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China. Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Zhejiang Dinglong New Materials Co., Ltd.
